record.content_text:
In your daily life, you may come across large numbers in newspapers, on television shows and in some of your other school subjects.

Whenever you get stuck with a large number, write the number in a place value table to help you make sense of it. Remember the order of the place value table:

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|}
  \hline
    \textbf{trillion} &\text{hundred billion} &\text{ten billion} &\textbf{billion} & \text{hundred million} & \text{ten million} & \textbf{million} &\text{hundred thousand} & \text{ten thousand} & \textbf{thousand} & \text{hundred} & \text{  ten  } & \text{  unit  }  \\
    (1,000,000,000,000) & (100,000,000,000) & (10,000,000,000) & (1,000,000,000) & (100,000,000) & (10,000,000) & (1,000,000) & (100,000) & (10,000) & (1,000) & (100) & (10) & (1) \\
    \hline
     & & & & & & & & & & & &    \\
    \hline
    \end{array}
$$

record.prompt_text:
### Exercise 1.13: Use large numbers to solve problems

6. In 2018, the Federal Government of Nigeria estimated the following budget allocations to three of their ministries: ₦435.01 billion to Education, ₦444.43 billion to Defence and ₦269.34 billion to Health. Calculate the total allocation to all three ministries. Write the full number and give its name.
record.answer_text:
$$
\begin{array}{r r r}
 & 435.01\times1,000,000,000 & = 435,010,000,000 \\
 +& 444.43\times1,000,000,000 & = 444,430,000,000 \\
+& 269.34\times1,000,000,000 & = 269,340,000,000 \\
\hline
& &  1,148,780,000,000\\
\hline
\end{array}
$$

The total allocation is ₦1,148,780,000,000. It is one trillion one hundred and forty eight billion seven hundred and eighty million naira.
